senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; ארי , v. preced.) [the light-colored]

units: B. Kam. 16ᵇ א׳ תרבות a tamed lion; a. fr.—Transf. brave man; distinguished scholar (opp. שועל).
<cite ref="Gittin 83b">Gitt. 83ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. IX, 50ᵃ <he>אין משיבין את הא׳ וכ׳</he> you must not argue against a lion (scholar) after he is dead.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:22">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אֲרָיוֹת</he>.—<he>זנב לא׳</he> a tail to lions, i.e. the least among the great (opp. head to foxes).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:15">Ab. IV, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 4:3:2">Y. Snh. IV, 22ᵇ</cite> bot.—

<cite ref="Chullin 3b:17">Ḥull. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>גירי א׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:2">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>א׳ גסטריות</he>, v. <cite ref="C01169"><he>גַּסְטְרָא</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: Leo, Lion the fifth sign of the Zodiac (corresp. to the month of Ab).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 418:1">Yalk. Ex. 418</cite>. Pesik. Dibré p. 116ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 27:1">Pesik. R. s. 27</cite> (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 28:1">28</cite>, p. 133ᵇ, ed. Fr.); v. <cite ref="A03083"><he>אֲרִיאֵל</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: homiletic surname of the Lord, Israel &c. Pesik. l. c.; Pesik. R. l. c.; Yalk. Jer. 259, v. אֲרִיאֵל.
